clue.effect: increments public clue counter by one
clue.limitations: No actual clue text or objective-specific clue payload exists in the content schema.

memory.effect: increments public clue counter by one
memory.limitations: Currently shares the same runtime effect as clue; memory-specific reminder and round expiry are not implemented.

modifier.effect: reduces next drawn card intensity cap to at most 1
modifier.limitations: Does not rewrite the card instruction; only applies the intensity filter.

route.effect: grants one skip token for one eligible ordinary single-exit field
route.limitations: Does not allow skipping checkpoints, events, forks, or finale.

resource.effect: adds one shared resource, capped at teamResourceMax
resource.limitations: No event currently decreases shared resource; shield behavior therefore needs a negative-resource event to be fully exercised.

JOKER.effect: replace an unrevealed active card with a card from a different requested category
JOKER.limitations: Requested category must have an eligible card; no once-per-scenario ledger is currently enforced.

TARCZA.limitations: Content says event loss only; runtime shield is checked by outcome application too. No current event consumes it.

KOMPAS.limitations: Does not identify the nearest checkpoint or reveal checkpoint-specific clue text.

ZAMROŻENIE.effect: adds up to 20 seconds to timerExtensionSec
ZAMROŻENIE.limitations: Timer UI/countdown integration is outside the engine; engine does not decrement a clock.

WSPÓŁPRACA.effect: sets activeCollaborator and emits assistance event after card resolution
WSPÓŁPRACA.limitations: Does not yet apply a dedicated duo card variant or enforce non-duplicated award rules across every outcome.

PRZERZUT.effect: consumes PRZERZUT and replaces a pending die result before movement
PRZERZUT.limitations: The card inventory code must use the exact PRZERZUT identifier.

ZWIADOWCA.effect: reveals adjacent node IDs and types
ZWIADOWCA.limitations: Reveals only immediate adjacent fields, not necessarily two fields ahead on the chosen route; preview reset/expiry is not enforced.

REZERWA.effect: adds one shared resource, capped at maximum
